purpose: Boot the backend runtime that ships INSIDE the notarized DMG, against a brand-new empty data root, to prove the packaged runtime is self-provisioning before the clean-account customer chain runs. This is supporting evidence only; it does NOT stand in for the clean-account customer chain.

how.flags_identical_to_real_launch: The installed app launches the same binary with --desktop --headless --host --port --data-dir (observed via ps); only host/port/data-dir were changed here to avoid colliding with the user's running instance on 17500.

result.boot: Application startup complete. Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:17501
result.health_note: status=degraded immediately after boot is the documented warm-up state; runtime.status is already 'healthy'.

fresh_root_provisioning.migration_lock: data/.xcagi-migration.lock present => migrations ran on the fresh root
fresh_root_provisioning.verdict: PASS - a brand-new data root is fully provisioned by the packaged runtime itself (main DB + migrations + 14 bundled mods).

observations.observed: app.db.init_db logs WARN '无法为 Mod <id> 准备专用库：母库不存在 <root>/products.db|inventory.db|voice_learning.db|error_collection.db（跳过 ...）' for several mods on the fresh root.
observations.why_not_yet_a_defect: These are the mod parent DBs; they are created lazily when the corresponding business feature is first used. The backend continues, runtime.status=healthy, 0 required/optional component failures, and 14 mods are provisioned. The user's long-lived install does have products.db but no inventory.db/voice_learning.db either, so absence on a fresh root is consistent with lazy creation.
observations.to_verify_in_clean_chain: During the clean-account real-business step, confirm the relevant parent DB is created on first use and that the business write/read round-trip succeeds. If it does not, this becomes a real defect to fix and regression-test.
